label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
@Rohan fair question da, and Divya is right to ask. You trusted me with real money, so you get a real answer. Sneha, thanks, but let him ask, I'd rather he hear it from me than from my LinkedIn post.

Ajay, "cricket captain after losing the series" is exactly what it is. That post took me four drafts to say "I fired people" in a way that doesn't sound like I fired people.

Okay, straight version.

Last Friday I let go of 6 of our 14. Worst day of my life, and I'm including failing maths in 2nd sem. Everyone got 2 months' pay, and I've already helped 4 of them get interviews. I'm still not sleeping great about it.

Why it happened: the bridge round from the Hyderabad fund fell through on 28 Oct. The term sheet was basically ready. The partner told us on the call "we love the energy", and then disappeared for 11 days. Turns out energy doesn't wire money. Noted for next time.

Where we are now: about 5 months of runway after the cuts. The app has around 41k monthly users. The plumber and electrician side is growing properly. The AC servicing side is bleeding money, so we're shutting it. The plan is to focus on housing society tie-ups, and 3 societies in HSR have already signed pilots.

Now your 3 lakh. It's at risk, but it's not gone. I'm not going to tell you it's safe, because I genuinely don't know, and you'd see through me anyway. I do think we have a real shot with the societies, but it's not a sure thing. Your money is on the same terms as everyone else's in the friends round, no special treatment either way. So Divya's answer is "yes, it's still a thing, and it's a risky thing." Don't start the sad face yet, but maybe don't retire the idea of it either.

I don't want to explain all this in a group chat between dosa plans, so let me call you and Divya properly this week. I'll show you the actual numbers, the runway, the pilots, all of it, and you can ask me anything. Tell me which evening works and I'll block it. If after seeing the numbers Divya has more questions, good, she should.

For the rest of you, since Sneha is giving me the worried look through the phone: I'm fine. Mostly. I'm at the office till late most nights and I've eaten so much Maggi there that the security uncle now asks me "masala or plain?" without looking up. Amma asked last week if TCS is still hiring, which I'm choosing to take as encouragement.

But I'm coming on Saturday, no excuses from my side. Pranav is buying, he said it himself, there are screenshots. I want the proper dosa, the proper beer, and one evening where nobody asks me about runway except maybe Rohan, and only until the second round.

Rohan, thanks for asking me straight instead of just worrying quietly. I'd rather have the awkward conversation than have you and Divya guessing over dinner.

Call this week. Saturday, I'll see you all there. 🍻
